note: Actual local CPU inference on the SHA-bound natural audio files. No expected text/pinyin/filenames supplied to either neural encoder. Posteriors are uncalibrated.

models.method: Dominant initial and tone-bearing final from frame posteriors, averaged over frames predicted in that category. No score-based approval.
FP32 ONNX; 16kHz, peak normalization, Kaldi80 Hamming25/10ms, 7/6 LFR, official CMVN, dither0, blind greedy CTC. Multiple or absent tokens abstain.
